Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system

Class LfsUpdateService

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.LfsUpdateService
public final class LfsUpdateService extends Object
Whole-system update front-end for the LFS/BLFS target, normative in system-management-contract.md §4.2. It drives the builder-installed /usr/bin/lfs-update (check|status|upgrade) and never re-implements the updater: lfs-update upgrade already backs up /etc+/boot, runs lpm update-db/lpm upgrade, detects a kernel change and rebuilds the kernel + GRUB. This class only builds argument vectors and parses/normalises the tool's output.

This is the third layer of the update model and MUST NOT be conflated with the other two: update-manager auto-updates the lg3d bundle itself (version.json, PGP-verified); lpm manages individual packages (lpm-console); lfs-update updates the whole system.

The command-building, ANSI-stripping and status/check parsing are pure and unit-testable (buildCommand(org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.LfsUpdateService.Action), stripAnsi(java.lang.String), parseStatus(java.lang.String), interpretCheck(int)); the run* helpers are thin wrappers over ProcessRunner (read-only check/ status) and PrivilegedRunner (the mutating, polkit-escalated upgrade). lfs-update emits ANSI colour with no disable switch, so all output is passed through stripAnsi(java.lang.String) (§3.1).

  • Method Details

    • isAvailable

      public static boolean isAvailable()
      True if /usr/bin/lfs-update is present on this host.

    • isMutating

      public static boolean isMutating(LfsUpdateService.Action action)

    • buildCommand

      public static List<String> buildCommand(LfsUpdateService.Action action)
      Builds the argument vector for action: lfs-update <sub>. Returns an empty list for null. The result is meant to be handed straight to ProcessRunner / PrivilegedRunner.

    • stripAnsi

      public static String stripAnsi(String text)
      Strips ANSI escape sequences (colour, cursor moves, OSC titles) from text. lfs-update colourises with no disable switch, so the contract (§3.1, §6) requires stripping rather than parsing the escapes.

    • interpretCheck

      public static LfsUpdateService.CheckVerdict interpretCheck(int exitCode)
      Interprets a lfs-update check exit code as a verdict: 1 = up to date (§3.2 uses the exit code as state), 0 = updates available, anything else = the check errored.

    • parseStatus

      public static LfsUpdateService.StatusSnapshot parseStatus(String rawOutput)
      Parses lfs-update status output into a LfsUpdateService.StatusSnapshot. ANSI is stripped first, then both KEY=value and key: value lines are captured into a case-insensitive field map; unrecognised lines are ignored. Pure and lenient: an unknown format yields an empty snapshot rather than throwing.

    • readLfsVersion

      public static String readLfsVersion()
      Best-effort read of /etc/lfs-version (read-only, §3.5). Returns an empty string when the file is absent (as on a non-LFS dev host).

    • runRead

      public static ProcessRunner.Result runRead(LfsUpdateService.Action action)
      Runs a read-only action (check or status) unprivileged through ProcessRunner. Returns a not-started result for the mutating upgrade action or an unsupported/null action.

    • runUpgrade

      public static PrivilegedRunner.PrivilegedResult runUpgrade()
      Runs lfs-update upgrade with polkit escalation through PrivilegedRunner. The caller is responsible for confirming with the user, running this off the EDT and streaming/progress-reporting (§3.6). Returns an ERROR result for a non-mutating action.
